sources.quote: effective today Meccanica C S.p.A. is on probation (supplier rating C minus)

findings.why: Meccanica C has been on probation since 2026-08-14. No later document lifts it, so it cannot receive a new part such as the BR-220 billet. The email is informal correspondence, so the current status should be confirmed.

sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The controlled approved supplier list covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL, and Meccanica C is not on it. Its approvals are for other parts (BR-180, BR-310). The BR-180 approval does not carry over to BR-220.

sources.quote: Rev C, 2026-06-01: material changed from EN AW-6061-T6 to EN AW-6082-T6; yield requirement raised from 240 MPa to 250 MPa; SC-01 introduced.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: The drawing in force (Rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6 with a yield of at least 250 MPa. The email says C's billet is EN AW-6061-T6 with 240 MPa minimum, which is the superseded Rev B requirement. C's offered material therefore does not meet the drawing in force.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: Rev C requires a 3.1 certificate with each lot. The documents contain no certificate or test result for any billet from Meccanica C, so nothing shows that its material meets 6082-T6 or the 250 MPa yield. A person must say whether such a certificate exists.
